action_summary: Restored the 5-fold BERT ensemble that scored 0.36763 in v21 (v22's single-fold run dropped to 0.35115), loading each fold checkpoint in a loop and freeing GPU memory between folds. Because the metric is Spearman, fold predictions are blended in rank space (average of per-fold column ranks mixed 50/50 with the rank of the plain mean), which is robust to calibration differences between folds. Added a cheap keyword/host based prior for the near-constant question_type_spelling column, blended with the BERT output as a tie-breaker. Minor hygiene: tokenizer built once instead of per example, and a space inserted between question title and body.
